visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a title screen featuring large yellow text on a black background. The scene transitions to a full-frame animation of a young male character wearing a dark gray t-shirt against a light gray background, who smiles and points upward with his right hand as if introducing a topic. (2) A visual illustration appears depicting a person in a state of mental distress, surrounded by chaotic, swirling lines and multiple shadowy hands and faces in shades of red, blue, and gray. Above the illustration, a large number 10 and the name of a mental disorder in Traditional Chinese are displayed prominently against a white banner. (3) The screen shifts to a simple graphic showing the fraction 1/300 in black text on a white background, accompanied by text explaining the prevalence rate. (5) Item 8 depicts a female character with long dark hair vigorously washing her hands at a sink, surrounded by floating red numbers and clock faces, illustrating compulsive behavior. (6) Item 7 features a man clutching his chest with both hands, looking wide-eyed and sweating profusely with small wavy lines around him, indicating a state of panic or shock. (7) Item 6 shows a person sitting on the ground, hunched over with their head resting on their knees, set against a dark, minimalist background to represent a somber mood. (8) Item 5 displays a person looking anxious and sweating, surrounded by blurry silhouettes of other people, representing a crowded social environment. (9) Item 4 shows a girl sitting at a table, looking dejectedly at a bowl of food in front of her, her hand resting on her chin. (10) Item 3 illustrates a person covering their face with their hands, with thought bubbles above them showing car accidents and warning signs, representing traumatic memories. (11) Item 2 features a character clutching their head while a large cloud of chaotic, tangled scribbles and currency symbols appears behind them. (12) Item 1 shows a person lying in bed with a blanket pulled up to their chin, staring wide-eyed at the ceiling in a dark room. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track opens with a vibrant, upbeat acoustic pop background track featuring a driving drum beat and light melodic synth chords. A male voice speaks with clear, professional enunciation and a friendly tone, asking an introductory question at a brisk speech rate. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound marks the start of the first list item. The narrator provides the name of the disorder with high clarity. This is followed immediately by a 'pop' sound as the statistical fraction is mentioned. (3) The sequence continues with recurring 'whoosh' sounds for each new list item (9 down to 1), interspersed with the narrator's consistent and energetic delivery of names and numbers. (4) Each transition between the disorder name and the prevalence statistic is punctuated by a subtle high-frequency 'ding' or 'pop' sound effect, maintaining a rhythmic and informative pace. (5) As the video nears its end, the music maintains its tempo but the narrator's voice ceases, leaving the upbeat track to play out over the final text-heavy disclaimer screen. (6) The overall mix is extremely clean with a high signal-to-noise ratio, typical of a professional studio recording for educational social media content.
